en-US.description:
Gently Reset is a cozy daily reset for when you want to feel more like yourself, without the pressure.

It's not a 30-day challenge. It's a lifelong reset, one season at a time. Answer a few questions and get a plan built around you: your focus, your energy and the time you actually have. Each 30-day season builds on the last, for as long as it helps.

Every day is a short list of ten small, real-life things, like a walk at talking pace, a message to someone you miss or a ten-minute tidy. Tick any three and you've checked in.

WHAT YOU GET
• A personal plan across mind, energy, habits, confidence, relationships or direction that grows with you, season after season
• Ten small things a day, sized to your time. Any three count
• A little companion who cheers you on and naps when the day is done
• A cozy room that grows every time you check in, and a new room every season
• A private journal to notice how you're doing
• Friends, if you want them: see each other's day and send a kind word
• A home screen widget for your day and streak

Miss a day? Just continue. That's the whole point.

SUBSCRIPTION
Gently Reset Pro unlocks the app and is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.gentlyreset.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.gentlyreset.com/privacy
